basic_profile.bio: A recent Clemson University alum who just started diving into the Reddit world. Passionate about college football, especially anything related to Clemson Tigers. Currently living in Greenville, SC, and working as a junior graphic designer. Loves music, with a particular fondness for MF DOOM and hip-hop culture. Dislikes negativity and toxic online environments. Typically online during evenings and weekends. Single and enjoying the post-college life.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Primarily knowledgeable in graphic design and sports, gained through a degree in graphic design and a lifelong interest in college football. Also has a growing interest in hip-hop culture, self-taught by exploring music and online discussions.
